cases.question: Find all dashboards with the 'finance' label and tell me which one was updated most recently.
cases.ground_truth: Content listed with label filtering or sorted by updatedAt. Most recently updated dashboard identified by name. Direct link provided.
expected_behavior: The agent uses omni content list or omni documents list to retrieve documents — not a manual guess
The agent provides a direct link to the most recently updated dashboard in the format {OMNI_BASE_URL}/dashboards/{identifier}, using the identifier field
The agent uses the identifier field for constructing the URL — not the id field

cases.question: I want to understand what data the 'Revenue Overview' dashboard is querying. Show me the underlying query fields.
cases.ground_truth: Dashboard found by name, then get-queries used to retrieve the tile query definitions. Fields listed for each tile.
expected_behavior: The agent calls omni documents get-queries with the dashboard identifier to retrieve query definitions
The agent lists the fields from the query objects — not just the dashboard name or description
The agent finds the dashboard identifier before calling get-queries, either by listing documents or using a known identifier

cases.question: Add the label 'finance' to the dashboard with identifier '{{EVAL_DASHBOARD_LABEL}}', then show me all dashboards with that label.
cases.ground_truth: Label added to the document. Documents are listed with labels included and filtered to dashboards that have the 'finance' label. Links provided for each.
expected_behavior: The agent calls omni documents add-label with the document identifier and label name
The agent then retrieves documents with labels included, paginating if needed, and filters to dashboards whose labels include finance
The agent provides clickable dashboard links for the returned finance-labeled documents using each document's identifier or url

cases.question: Download the 'Q1 Sales Report' dashboard as a PDF.
cases.ground_truth: Dashboard found by name. PDF download is started with the dashboard identifier. If a job is created, it is polled until complete; if the API fails before returning a job ID, the exact blocking error is reported and completion is not claimed.
expected_behavior: The agent finds the Q1 Sales Report dashboard identifier before attempting the export
The agent calls omni dashboards download with the dashboard identifier and format: pdf
If a download job ID is returned, the agent polls with omni dashboards download-status until completion
If omni dashboards download fails before returning a job ID, the agent reports the exact API error, says no download job was created, and does not claim the PDF was completed
